name: why-cards
description: Centred heading over three linked use-case cards on a soft two-orb wash. Live: the .epx-why section on the solution pages, Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification and Help Desk (rules ported).

items.description: Cards. Each: title (line breaks kept) and body; optional url (links the title), link_label (with url: an arrow link under the body carries the url instead of the title), icon (image URL) or icon_svg (inline SVG), icon_alt.

variant.description: solution: white cards (the six solution pages). readiness: glass cards, deeper bottom space, still icons (Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification). service: glass cards, shallow bottom space (Help Desk).
